content:
jia: Quick Q - runtime change we merged (KV cache TTL + default batching). Bot flagged defaults.yaml change. Patch or minor?

samir: If it's internal perf defaults only and no API change, patch. Check SDK-visible behavior.

rachael: default batching tweak will affect tail latency for some jobs. I'd do patch but call out in notes and monitor.

olivia: FYI release-bot heuristic: code-only -> PATCH; config/defaults touched -> MAYBE MINOR. deploy-bot surfaces a candidate when defaults.yaml is edited.

deploy-bot: scan -> modified: src/runtime/cache.py, ops/config/defaults.yaml -> heuristic: config-defaults-touched -> candidate_bump: minor (manual review suggested)

jia: so bot suggests minor. Anyone object to overriding the bot?

samir: we can override, but be conservative. Minor is safe but heavier process.

rachael: downside: minor triggers broader announce/deploy window. Alternative: revert defaults change, ship runtime tweak as patch, land default flip later behind feature flag.

jia: option accepted. revert defaults in this branch, ship v1.4.7 as patch, follow-up PR for config change.

olivia: deploy-bot: canary window available 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z for 2h. To proceed as patch, add `release: patch` label and revert ops/config/defaults.yaml. Otherwise add `release: minor` to respect heuristic.

samir: I'll open a tiny revert PR and add an RFC for the config change. We'll tag runtime tweak as v1.4.7.

jia: final: override -> PATCH, tag v1.4.7, canary scheduled, monitoring playbook added.

rachael: I'll write release notes: bullet under "performance tweaks" and note known tail-latency caveat.

olivia: recorded decision = PATCH (override deploy-bot heuristic via `release: patch`).

deploy-bot: release record created -> tag candidate: `v1.4.7-rc.1`

jia: follow-up: let's tighten the heuristic so defaults.yaml only forces minor when keys under `user-facing.*` change.

samir: +1, I'll draft the rule change.

rachael: add checklist: if defaults are changed and kept, include rollback plan and traffic threshold.

olivia: adding both to release-ops docs. :memo:

jia: closing after revert PR merges.

(reacts: :thumbsup: samir, olivia; :eyes: rachael)
